content: If DET is enabled and the RAM test execution status is ne i ther RAMTST_EXECUTION_STOPPED nor RAMTST_EXECUTION_SUSPENDED , the Specification of RAM Test AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 54 of 89 Document ID 76 : AUTOSAR_SWS_RAMTest function RamTst_RunPartialTest shall report the error value RAMTST_E_STATUS_FAILURE to the DET, and then immediately return.

If DET is enabled and the RAM test execution status is ne i ther RAMTST_EXECUTION_STOPPED nor RAMTST_EXECUTION_SUSPENDED , the function RamTst_RunPartialTest shall report the error value RAMTST_E_STATUS_FAI LURE to the DET, and then immediately return.
